Sleep Posture Scan

See how your head, neck and spine line up when you lie on your side, on your own bed and pillow, and get suggestions for your pillow and mattress.

Take the photo

  1. Lie on your usual side, on your own mattress and pillow, the way you normally sleep. Wear thin, close-fitting clothes and keep the duvet off your back.
  2. Stay still for about 10 minutes so the pillow and mattress settle.
  3. For a measurement in centimetres, lay an A4 sheet flat on the mattress just behind your back, long side along your body.
  4. Someone stands behind you and takes the photo with the phone level with your back, showing you from the top of your head to your hips.

3D scan

The iPhone app uses the LiDAR or Face ID depth camera to measure your back in 3D, so there is nothing to tap.

Demo: a simulated person

Move the sliders to change how a simulated person lies on their bed. The app builds a 3D scan of them and measures it exactly as it would a real scan.

Your result

Your scans

Change one thing at a time (for example the pillow), scan again, and compare.

About this prototype. It gives comfort guidance, not a diagnosis. The thresholds (head within ±5°, waist within ±2% of trunk length, shoulders and hips within ±4°) are provisional and not yet validated. If you have neck or back pain, numbness, or pain that wakes you, see a doctor or physiotherapist.

Nothing leaves your phone: photos and scans are processed on the device.
